rules.ordering: harvest_day then lot_id; existing dispatches/releases before new harvests
rules.settlement: floor(actual arrival day), arrival must be before day 30
rules.spoilage: cumulative linear exposure against each day's original heat-adjusted life; cold rate 0.25; cap at initial kg
rules.transport: origin-region dispatch-day rain adds 24h once; origin-region weather along the journey
rules.storage: reserve original kg on [harvest, dispatch); bill reserved original kg until departure/expiry, release on observed expiry
rules.baseline: nearest-market harvest-day dispatch; ignores soft risk margin, cannot sell spoiled kg
rules.missingPolicyC: no invented action or full-cohort totals; resolved-lot simulation is an isolated preview
